'''Rob Farallo''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Parker tournament]] on 17 March 2001 with Incom Corp (X-Wings and Speeders), according to Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1972">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-28-seth-goes-to-parker-3-17-00d1972/ seth-goes-to-parker-3-17-00], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 28 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-28-seth-goes-to-parker-3-17-00d1972/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
